summary: REQ-1 and REQ-2 appear implemented via branding updates in AppHeader/Login/index.html and a new shared post-login redirect helper. There is insufficient evidence in the provided diff summary that REQ-3 (header dropdown link to /admin/users for super_admin) or the route/guard changes required by REQ-4 and REQ-5 were implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the User Management screen at route /admin/users is accessible from the Chat experience via the header dropdown menu for super_admin users.
missing_requirements.reason: AppHeader was updated to show the new brand name, but no changes are shown for the header profile dropdown/menu component to add a super_admin-only "User Management" item that navigates to /admin/users.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove any routing/guard behavior that blocks super_admin or admin users behind dashboard-only screens; admins should be able to stay on /chat without being redirected to dashboard-only pages.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary does not include any changes to the routing/guard layer (e.g., App routing/guards) that would prevent redirects to /admin or other dashboard-only routes.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure super_admin always has access to /admin/users without being routed through or blocked by the approval flow; approval gating applies only to non-admin users.
missing_requirements.reason: While the new post-login redirect helper prioritizes admin roles over approval status, there is no evidence of route-guard logic updates ensuring super_admin can access /admin/users even if unapproved and is never redirected to /pending-approval when navigating there.
